contradictions.topic: Canh Tứ Hóa lineage conflict (Khoa / Kỵ cells)
contradictions.description: Across lineages, Canh Khoa/Kỵ cells differ (阳武府同 vs 阳武同阴 etc.). Wang-attributed lecture aligns Khoa=Thiên Phủ with TC runtime, but Nam Phái and other lineages differ. Expert adjudication still required — not resolved by source count.

contradictions.topic: Mậu Khoa — released TC runtime vs Wang-attributed lecture
contradictions.description: Released TC engineering policy sets Mậu Khoa → Hữu Bật. Inspected Wang-attributed primary-lecture reproduction decodes 戊贪阴阳机 as Khoa → Thái Dương. This is runtime↔source mismatch, not a source-vs-source contradiction.

contradictions.topic: Nhâm Khoa — released TC runtime vs Wang-attributed lecture
contradictions.description: Released TC sets Nhâm Khoa → Tả Phụ. Wang-attributed lecture 壬梁紫府武 decodes Khoa → Thiên Phủ. Runtime↔source mismatch pending expert review.

contradictions.topic: Legacy FlowMonthEntry calendar metadata vs contract
contradictions.description: Calculation Core populates FlowMonthEntry.stem/branch from focus-palace-derived values, while public ChartEngine contract and Zhongzhou research treat calendar month Can/Chi as independent. Monthly Flow V1 scorer uses provider.stemBranchForLunarMonth — SCORING_BUG=NO.
contradictions.resolution: PR #263 characterized the debt and marked FlowMonthEntry.stem/branch @deprecated for calendar interpretation; runtime values preserved. Field removal deferred to RQ-TC-012.
